text:
leah_m: Hey team — quick sync on prelaunch SEO for the webinar + launch posts. Main goals: canonical strategy, redirects, schema for webinar landing, and inbound lead routing (UTMs -> SFDC).
omar_k: +1. Can we split into tidy checklist? I can own redirects sweep and canonical checks.
ev an_s: tagging in analytics — need final UTM map before publish. When do we lock copy?
leah_m: Lock copy by EOD Tue. Evan, can you drop the UTM map here when ready?
alex_r: I'll draft the JSON-LD schema for the webinar page. Do we want speaker microdata + eventAttendanceMode?
seo-bot: Reminder: run automated canonical crawl after redirects are deployed: /tools/crawl?site=redwood.dev&mode=canonical-scan
omar_k: Redirect plan I'm thinking: preserve old blog permalinks -> new launch hub, 301s, and a fallback index for unknown patterns. I'll post mapping.
leah_m: Good. Also want an internal-link plan: top nav + resource hub + cross-links from docs. Prioritize pages with >100 sessions/mo.
evan_s: For lead routing: UTM source=webinar, campaign=launch_q2, medium=organic-social. Map to SFDC campaign: "Launch Q2 Webinar". Also map form type to lead routing queue A/B.
alex_r: Quick schema snippet (draft):
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-14T16:00:00Z",
  "eventAttendanceMode": "https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode",
  "performer": [{"@type":"Person","name":"Leah M."}],
  "organizer": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}
}
```
omar_k: Nice — include offers/ticket if we gate. For redirects, here's an initial mapping (examples):
```
/old-blog/intro-llm-costs -> /resources/launch/llm-economics (301)
/old-blog/benchmarks -> /resources/launch/benchmarks (301)
/webinar-reg -> /events/launch-2026/register (302 temp during promo)
```
leah_m: Good to mark webinar-reg as 302 until post-event then swap to 301 after archive. Also add canonical tag to archived post pointing to /resources/launch/benchmarks.
evan_s: Analytics note: add hidden field in the form: utm_campaign origin + webinar_id. That way we can tie leads back to the registration session.
alex_r: SEO checklist I propose (short): 1) schema (Event, FAQ) 2) redirects sweep 3) canonical verification 4) internal link insertions (top 10 pages) 5) UTM map -> SFDC 6) GTM tag test 7) publish & smoke-crawl
leah_m: Assignments: redirects -> @omar_k, schema -> @alex_r, UTMs + SFDC mapping -> @evan_s, internal links -> me. Publish owner -> product-marketing.
omar_k: I'll open a GH ticket and paste the full redirects CSV. ETA: Thu morning.
alex_r: I'll finish schema + FAQ JSON-LD and push to staging by Wed.
evan_s: I'll post UTM map and GTM test plan tomorrow.
leah_m: Last ask: when we switch from 302 -> 301 post-event, schedule a redirect smoke test and re-run canonical crawler. Add a note to the release calendar.
seo-bot: Scheduled crawl reminder set for 2026-04-21 09:00Z.
leah_m: Perfect. Thanks all — short follow-ups in the tickets. :+1:
